description: This file defines static utility methods for overriding configuration options using named options within the Orleans framework, specifically focusing on cluster options and handling provider-specific overrides.

classes.name: OptionsOverrides
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving overridable cluster options and generic option retrieval based on provider name.

methods.name: GetProviderClusterOptions
methods.description: Retrieves ClusterOptions for a specific provider, allowing overrides on a per-provider basis.

methods.name: GetOverridableOption
methods.description: Generic method to fetch options which can be overridden by a named service, falling back to default options.
